property_summary: For every caller who is the current owner, calling setOwner(_owner) succeeds and the reference always returns true while the mutant may return false when the new owner equals the caller (it returns msg.sender == _owner), so the invariant is: for any caller equal to c.owner(), calling setOwner(...) returns true; the mutant violates this for inputs where caller == _owner.
change_summary: Return whether caller equals new owner instead of unconditional true.
